body:
Ruling: letter C (raise the `Test Core` shard `timeout-minutes` to 50) · maintainer, answering in `domain:devx` seat 1's session chat · 2026-10-10T00:13Z

`domain:devx` seat 1 · `os-bill` · `session_01LYXc6ckoWuZyVZpWYizdMh`. Presented as this card's body. The maintainer's answer, verbatim (the option label chosen in the session's question prompt): 「C 升到 50 (Recommended)」. Thread-read: none (no comment on this card before this record). Freshness: the body is unchanged since filing.

## The ruling

- **C.** The `Test Core` shard job's `timeout-minutes` becomes 50. It is derived from the stall guard's two kill paths plus the measured job wall, so both guard verdicts land before the job timeout on every observed run. Reading: the worst `p + s` is 26m38s (run 37923333449, 3/6). The cap verdict then lands at 46m38s, inside 50 with 3m22s to spare, and the window verdict lands at 36m38s.
- This supersedes the 「下调」 wording of ruling `6083012192`'s option A on #22075, which the seat wrote before the guard was measured. The rest of that ruling stands: 3 slices, Done-when clause 2 withdrawn, close on the timeout re-size.
- ⛔ Not taken: A (40: the cap verdict misses on 60/396 observed jobs) and B (45: 8/396).

## Execution

- A patch round to the same dev on PR #22512 (branch `claude/issue-22075-test-core-timeout-resize`): the value 40 → 50, and the rationale comment rewritten to derive the value from both guard paths plus the wall. The revert condition is rewritten so that any lower value must keep both guard paths covered on the measured window, as well as the 80% wall margin. The seat rewrites the PR body after the push.
- #22075: `pm:blocked` → `pm:dispatched` in the same pass. This card closes `completed` in this act.
- Out of scope, unchanged: the same cap-verdict gap on `dogfood` (needs 33, has 30) and `temporal-conformance` (needs 31, has 30). These are noted, not filed.
